issues.description: The problem statement (UML and task description) specifies getTotalNumberOfStudents() as a public method, but the solution implements it with protected visibility. The template's TODO also directs students to implement this method per the UML (which uses a public '+' marker). This visibility mismatch can confuse students about the intended accessibility and may cause tests or examples that expect a public method to fail or be inaccessible.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the getTotalNumberOfStudents() method public in the implementation to match the UML and task description. Update the method signature in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java to 'public int getTotalNumberOfStudents()' (in both template guidance and solution) so visibility is consistent with the specification.
